sources.starting_training: API22_1 meet 1/3; canonical KRA website meet 2

storage_contract: Repeated collection reuses business keys; observations and raw versions are separate history.
Jeju starting occurrences remain separate; ordinal slots are not official event IDs or timestamps.
Empty responses preserve old rows and are labelled observed_empty, not proof of no training.
Validated nonempty Jeju snapshots may retire stale current slots; archived prior source files remain.
Hill full-row hashes preserve distinct observations; an altered source value is not assumed to be the same event.
A session advisory lock protects this worker; per-date transaction locks protect standard/start writers.
Models and prediction inputs are not changed by this worker.

discord_proposal.secret: dedicated horse-racing Discord webhook in Secret Manager; do not reuse Fintor automatically
discord_proposal.delivery: send after DB commits; wait=true and allowed_mentions.parse=[]
discord_proposal.failure_isolation: Discord failure must not retry successful ingestion; separately retry notification
discord_proposal.crash_fallback: Cloud Monitoring needed for timeout/process crash before webhook dispatch

remaining_before_activation: Review incremental Cloud costs before creating billable resources.
Validate this new worker with one supervised production/cloud execution and durable raw-file verification.
Create and activate the daily Scheduler only after validation; current code is not a registered cron.
Prepare dedicated Discord channel/webhook, inject secret and test delivery separately.
Add monitoring for missed runs/older-than-seven-day gaps; do not silently expand the user-approved window.
Cloud worker updates Supabase only; local SQLite mirroring is not included.
